name: app.R
content:
# SRBC Signal2Noise ----------------------------------------------------------------
# Predicts stream biodiversity (Hill's N1, Hill's N2, Margalef) for benthic
# macroinvertebrates and fish from water-quality conditions using GAMs.
#
# Programmed by Pranita, Sri, Emily, Ziyuan, and Igor (2019); modernized 2026.
# Run with shiny::runApp() from this folder. Helpers live in R/ (auto-sourced).

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(plotly)

app <- load_app_data()   # cached GAMs + prepared data (data/model_cache.rds)
news <- read_news()

ui <- page_navbar(
  id = "nav",
  title = tags$span(class = "brand",
                    tags$img(src = "HU_E3_Favicon.jpg", alt = "", height = 26),
                    APP_TITLE),
  window_title = APP_TITLE,
  theme = app_theme(),
  fillable = FALSE,
  navbar_options = navbar_options(bg = "#0B3C5D", theme = "dark", collapsible = TRUE),
  header = tags$head(
    tags$link(rel = "icon", type = "image/jpeg", href = "HU_E3_Favicon.jpg"),
    tags$link(rel = "stylesheet", href = "styles.css")
  ),
  sidebar = scenario_sidebar(app),
  nav_panel("Overview", value = "overview", icon = icon("house"), mod_overview_ui("overview")),
  nav_panel("Biotic Response", value = "biotic", icon = icon("seedling"), mod_biotic_ui("biotic")),
  nav_panel("Sensitivity", value = "sensitivity", icon = icon("sliders"),
            mod_sensitivity_ui("sensitivity")),
  nav_panel("Model Diagnostics", value = "diagnostics", icon = icon("stethoscope"),
            mod_diagnostics_ui("diagnostics")),
  nav_panel("Data", value = "data", icon = icon("table"), mod_data_ui("data", app)),
  nav_panel("Help", value = "help", icon = icon("circle-question"), mod_help_ui("help", app)),
  nav_spacer(),
  nav_item(news_popover(news)),
  nav_item(tags$a(href = "https://www.harrisburgu.edu", target = "_blank", rel = "noopener",
                  class = "nav-link py-1",
                  tags$img(src = "E3Logo.jpg", alt = "Harrisburg University", height = 30,
                           class = "rounded")))
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  taxa <- reactive(input$taxa %||% "macro")

  values <- reactive({
    t <- taxa()
    vars <- c(TAXA_PREDICTORS[[t]], if (t == "macro") "StreamOrder")
    vals <- lapply(vars, function(v) input[[input_id(v, t)]])
    names(vals) <- vars
    req(all(!vapply(vals, is.null, logical(1))))
    vals
  }) |> debounce(120)

  scenario <- reactive({
    t <- taxa()
    v <- values()
    req(setequal(names(v), c(TAXA_PREDICTORS[[t]], if (t == "macro") "StreamOrder")))
    d <- app$data[[t]]
    list(taxa = t, values = v, data = d, models = app$models[[t]],
         newdata = scenario_frame(v, t, d))
  })

  observeEvent(input$reset, {
    t <- taxa()
    apply_scenario(session, t, default_scenario(app$data[[t]], t))
  })

  station_click <- mod_overview_server("overview", app, scenario)
  observeEvent(station_click(), {
    click <- station_click()
    vals <- station_scenario(app$data[[click$taxa]], click$station, click$taxa)
    req(vals)
    apply_scenario(session, click$taxa, vals)
    name <- app$stations$StationName[match(click$station, app$stations$StationID)]
    showNotification(sprintf("Loaded average conditions for %s (station %s).",
                             name %||% "station", click$station),
                     type = "message", duration = 4)
    nav_select("nav", "biotic")
  })

  mod_biotic_server("biotic", app, scenario)
  mod_sensitivity_server("sensitivity", app, scenario)
  mod_diagnostics_server("diagnostics", app, scenario)
  mod_data_server("data", app, scenario)
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

name: R/config.R
content:
# Signal2Noise: shared constants ---------------------------------------------
# Programmed by Pranita, Sri, Emily, Ziyuan, and Igor (2019); modernized 2026.

APP_TITLE <- "SRBC Signal2Noise"

PATHS <- list(
  data  = file.path("data", "DataAll.RData"),
  grid  = file.path("data", "Gam_Grid_outlier_removal.csv"),
  cache = file.path("data", "model_cache.rds"),
  news  = file.path("data", "messages.csv")
)

TAXA <- c(macro = "Macroinvertebrates", fish = "Fish")
TAXA_ICON <- c(macro = "bug", fish = "fish")

METRICS <- data.frame(
  id    = c("N1", "N2", "Margalef"),
  label = c("Hill's N1", "Hill's N2", "Margalef"),
  short = c(
    "Effective number of common taxa, exp(Shannon H')",
    "Effective number of dominant taxa, 1 / Simpson's sum p²",
    "Richness adjusted for sample size, (S - 1) / ln(N)"
  ),
  icon  = c("seedling", "layer-group", "list-ol"),
  floor = c(1, 1, 0),   # smallest value the index can take

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Continuous predictors used by the GAMs. `id` keeps the original 2019 input
# ids (ph_macro, watertemp_fish, ...). `coded` flags columns whose stored values
# look like factor level codes rather than measurements (see Help > Data notes).
PREDICTORS <- data.frame(
  var   = c("pH", "WaterTemp", "Turbidity", "SpCond", "O2Dis",
            "Oxygen", "Flow", "Alkalinity"),
  id    = c("ph", "watertemp", "turbidity", "spcond", "o2dis",
            "oxygen", "flow", "alkl"),
  label = c("pH", "Water temperature (°C)", "Turbidity",
            "Specific conductance", "Dissolved O₂ (mg/L)",
            "Oxygen (lab)", "Flow", "Alkalinity"),
  group = c(rep("Field sonde", 5), rep("Lab & hydrology", 3)),
  coded = c(FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

TAXA_PREDICTORS <- list(
  macro = PREDICTORS$var,                 # + StreamOrder (factor)
  fish  = setdiff(PREDICTORS$var, "Alkalinity")
)

CODED_NOTE <- paste(
  "Stored values (roughly 400 to 2,400) look like category codes rather than",
  "measurements. Treat this slider as a relative index; see Help > Data notes."
)

# Observations removed as outliers in the 2019 analysis (originally by row
# position: fish rows 30 and 37, macro row 53). Matched here by station and
# timestamp; timestamps are UTC, matching the stored tz ("GMT").
OUTLIERS <- list(
  fish  = data.frame(StationID = c(2029, 1669),
                     when = c("2013-06-17 20:00", "2014-07-22 00:00")),
  macro = data.frame(StationID = 2029, when = "2013-06-17 20:00")
)

PALETTE <- list(
  primary  = "#0B6E99",
  accent   = "#D9822B",
  observed = "#8A99A8",
  grid     = "#E6EBF0",
  ink      = "#1F2A37",
  order    = c("1" = "#9FC5E8", "2" = "#6FA8DC", "3" = "#3D85C6",
               "4" = "#0B6E99", "5" = "#E69138", "6" = "#B45F06")
)

metric_label <- function(id) METRICS$label[match(id, METRICS$id)]
predictor_label <- function(var) {
  ifelse(var == "StreamOrder", "Stream order",
         PREDICTORS$label[match(var, PREDICTORS$var)])
}
input_id <- function(var, taxa) {
  if (var == "StreamOrder") return(paste0("stro_", taxa))
  paste0(PREDICTORS$id[match(var, PREDICTORS$var)], "_", taxa)
}

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || (length(a) == 1 && is.na(a))) b else a

name: R/data_prep.R
content:
# Data preparation -------------------------------------------------------------
# Mirrors the 2019 pipeline in scripts/global.R (git history) step for step:
# rename lab columns, keep samples with a diversity score, mean-impute missing
# predictors, join station attributes (macro), and drop the flagged outliers.
# tests/testthat/test-models.R checks the predictions against the 2019 values.

LAB_RENAMES <- c(
  "Oxygen (mg/l)"     = "Oxygen",
  "Potassium (mg/l)"  = "Potassium",
  "Ammonia (mg/l)"    = "Ammonia",
  "Nitrate-N (mg/l)"  = "Nitrate",
  "Nitrite (mg/l)"    = "Nitrite",
  "Alkalinity (mg/l)" = "Alkalinity",
  "Flow (cfs)"        = "Flow"
)

rename_columns <- function(df, map) {
  hit <- names(df) %in% names(map)
  names(df)[hit] <- unname(map[names(df)[hit]])
  df
}

# Names of the predictors that are missing (and will be imputed) in each row.
imputed_label <- function(df, vars) {
  miss <- is.na(as.matrix(df[vars]))
  apply(miss, 1, function(r) paste(vars[r], collapse = ", "))
}

# Replace NAs with the column mean, as the original loop did.
impute_mean <- function(df, vars) {
  for (v in vars) {
    miss <- is.na(df[[v]])
    df[[v]][miss] <- mean(df[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  df
}

drop_outliers <- function(df, outliers) {
  key <- paste(df$StationID, format(df$DateTime, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = "UTC"))
  bad <- paste(outliers$StationID, outliers$when)
  stopifnot("outlier rows not found in data" = all(bad %in% key))
  df[!key %in% bad, , drop = FALSE]
}

station_table <- function(allDatat) {
  st <- allDatat[!duplicated(allDatat$StationID),
                 c("StationID", "Station.Name.x", "StreamOrder", "Longitude", "Latitude")]
  names(st)[2] <- "StationName"
  st$StationName <- as.character(st$StationName)
  st[order(st$StationID), ]
}

prepare_fish <- function(allData2) {
  # The 2019 code applied every lab rename except Alkalinity to the fish table.
  df <- rename_columns(allData2, LAB_RENAMES[names(LAB_RENAMES) != "Alkalinity (mg/l)"])
  df <- df[!is.na(df$Hills_N1), ]
  df$Imputed <- imputed_label(df, TAXA_PREDICTORS$fish)
  df <- impute_mean(df, TAXA_PREDICTORS$fish)
  df <- drop_outliers(df, OUTLIERS$fish)
  out <- data.frame(
    StationID   = df$StationID,
    StationName = as.character(df$StationName),
    DateTime    = df$DateTime,
    df[TAXA_PREDICTORS$fish],
    N1          = df$Hills_N1,
    N2          = df$Hills_N2,
    Margalef    = df$margalef,
    Imputed     = df$Imputed,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out
}

prepare_macro <- function(allData3, allDatat) {
  df <- rename_columns(allData3, LAB_RENAMES)
  df <- df[!is.na(df$Hills_N1_macro), ]
  df$Imputed <- imputed_label(df, TAXA_PREDICTORS$macro)
  df <- impute_mean(df, TAXA_PREDICTORS$macro)
  # Responses Hills_N1/N2 come from the station table (".y" after the join),
  # Margalef from the sample table, exactly as in the 2019 models.
  df <- merge(df, allDatat, by = c("DateTime", "StationID"), all = TRUE)
  df <- drop_outliers(df, OUTLIERS$macro)
  out <- data.frame(
    StationID   = df$StationID,
    StationName = as.character(df$Station.Name.x),
    DateTime    = df$DateTime,
    StreamOrder = df$StreamOrder,
    df[TAXA_PREDICTORS$macro],
    N1          = df$Hills_N1_macro.y,
    N2          = df$Hills_N2_macro.y,
    Margalef    = df$margalef_macro,
    Imputed     = df$Imputed,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out
}

load_raw_data <- function(path = PATHS$data) {
  env <- new.env()
  load(path, envir = env)
  as.list(env)[c("allData2", "allData3", "allDatat")]
}

higher means more", "wiggly). p-values test whether the smooth differs from zero.")), card(card_header("All six models"), tableOutput(ns("all_models")), uiOutput(ns("formula"))) ) ) } mod_diagnostics_server <- function(id, app, scenario) { moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) { all_summary <- do.call(rbind, unlist(lapply(names(TAXA), function(t) { lapply(METRICS$id, function(m) model_summary_row(app$models[[t]][[m]], t, m)) }), recursive = FALSE)) model <- reactive(scenario()$models[[input$metric]]) output$heading <- renderText(paste("Model diagnostics:", TAXA[[scenario()$taxa]])) output$stats <- renderUI({ m <- model() s <- summary(m) vb <- function(title, value, ic, ...) { value_box(title, value, ..., showcase = icon(ic), showcase_layout = "top right") } layout_column_wrap( width = "200px", class = "mb-3", vb("Samples", s$n, "vial"), vb("Deviance explained", sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * s$dev.expl), "chart-pie"), vb("Adjusted R²", fmt(s$r.sq, 3), "bullseye"), vb("GCV score", fmt(m$gcv.ubre, 3), "scale-balanced", p(class = "small mb-0", "lower is better")) ) }) fit_frame <- reactive({ m <- model() d <- scenario()$data data.frame(fitted = as.numeric(fitted(m)), observed = m$y, resid = as.numeric(residuals(m, type = "response")), station = d$StationName, date = format(d$DateTime, "%Y-%m-%d", tz = "UTC")) }) hover <- "%{customdata}

Residual %{y:.2f}

", "Click a station to load its average conditions into the scenario.", if (miss) sprintf(" %d station(s) have no coordinates and are not shown.", miss) else "") }) output$map <- renderPlotly({ st <- summary_tbl() st <- st[!is.na(st$Latitude), ] st$hover <- sprintf( "%s (ID %s)
Stream order %s · %d sample(s)
Mean Hill's N1 %s · N2 %s · Margalef %s", st$StationName, st$StationID, st$StreamOrder, st$samples, fmt(st$N1), fmt(st$N2), fmt(st$Margalef)) st$StreamOrder <- factor(st$StreamOrder, levels = names(PALETTE$order)) st$msize <- 9 + 19 * (st$N1 - min(st$N1)) / max(diff(range(st$N1)), 1e-9) # Plain lon/lat axes (no basemap: works offline, no WebGL or tile service). # A degree of latitude is 1/cos(lat) times longer than one of longitude. ratio <- 1 / cos(mean(range(st$Latitude)) * pi / 180) p <- plot_ly( st, x = ~Longitude, y = ~Latitude, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", customdata = ~StationID, color = ~StreamOrder, colors = PALETTE$order, marker = list(size = ~msize, line = list(color = "white", width = 1), opacity = 0.9), text = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text", source = "station_map" ) |> style_plot(xlab = "Longitude (°)", ylab = "Latitude (°)", legend = TRUE) |> layout( yaxis = list(scaleanchor = "x", scaleratio = ratio, title = list(text = "Latitude (°)"), gridcolor = PALETTE$grid, zeroline = FALSE), legend = list(title = list(text = "Stream order"), orientation = "v", x = 1.02, y = 1), margin = list(l = 60, r = 10, t = 10, b = 50), plot_bgcolor = "#F7F9FB" ) event_register(p, "plotly_click") }) # Station id of the latest click, for the app to load into the scenario. reactive({ click <- event_data("plotly_click", source = "station_map", priority = "event") req(click, click$customdata) list(taxa = isolate(scenario()$taxa), station = click$customdata, at = Sys.time()) }) }) }

# Sensitivity page: one-at-a-time response curves and a tornado ranking --------- mod_sensitivity_ui <- function(id) { ns <- NS(id) tagList( div(class = "d-flex flex-wrap align-items-end justify-content-between gap-3 mb-1", h4(class = "mb-2", textOutput(ns("heading"), inline = TRUE)), div(class = "d-flex flex-wrap gap-3", selectInput(ns("metric"), "Metric", width = "180px", choices = stats::setNames(METRICS$id, METRICS$label)), selectInput(ns("range"), "Tornado swing", width = "230px", choices = c("10th → 90th percentile" = "0.10", "25th → 75th percentile" = "0.25", "Minimum → maximum" = "0.00")))), p(class = "text-muted", "Each panel varies one driver across its sampled range while every other driver", "stays at the current scenario (set in the sidebar). Shaded bands are 95% confidence", "intervals; the orange line marks the current setting; ticks along the bottom show", "where samples were taken."), layout_columns( col_widths = breakpoints(sm = 12, xl = c(8, 4)), card(full_screen = TRUE, card_header(icon("wave-square"), " Response to each driver"), plotlyOutput(ns("curves"), height = "640px")), card(full_screen = TRUE, card_header(icon("ranking-star"), " Which drivers move the prediction most?"), plotlyOutput(ns("tornado"), height = "560px"), card_footer(class = "small text-muted", "Bars show how far the prediction moves when one driver goes from the", "low to the high end of the chosen range (others held at the scenario).", "Blue: the index rises with the driver; orange: it falls.", "For macroinvertebrates, stream order compares its lowest- and", "highest-scoring orders.")) ) ) } mod_sensitivity_server <- function(id, app, scenario) { moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) { output$heading <- renderText(paste("Sensitivity analysis:", TAXA[[scenario()$taxa]])) model <- reactive(scenario()$models[[input$metric]]) output$curves <- renderPlotly({ s <- scenario() m <- model() vars <- c(TAXA_PREDICTORS[[s$taxa]], if (s$taxa == "macro") "StreamOrder") curves <- lapply(vars, function(v) response_curve(m, s$newdata, s$data, v)) names(curves) <- vars cont <- setdiff(vars, "StreamOrder") ylim <- range(unlist(lapply(curves[cont], function(cv) c(cv$lwr, cv$upr)))) ylim <- ylim + c(-1, 1) * 0.04 * diff(ylim) lab <- metric_label(input$metric) panels <- lapply(vars, function(v) { cv <- curves[[v]] if (v == "StreamOrder") { cur <- as.character(s$newdata$StreamOrder) return( plot_ly(cv, x = ~x, y = ~fit, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", error_y = list(type = "data", symmetric = FALSE, array = ~upr - fit, arrayminus = ~fit - lwr, color = PALETTE$primary, thickness = 1.5, width = 5), marker = list(size = 9, color = ifelse(cv$x == cur, PALETTE$accent, PALETTE$primary)), hovertemplate = paste0("Stream order %{x}
", lab, " %{y:.2f}"), showlegend = FALSE) |> layout(xaxis = list(title = "Stream order", type = "category"), yaxis = list(title = "")) ) } x_now <- s$newdata[[v]][1] plot_ly(cv, x = ~x) |> add_ribbons(ymin = ~lwr, ymax = ~upr, fillcolor = "rgba(11,110,153,0.15)", line = list(width = 0), hoverinfo = "skip", showlegend = FALSE) |> add_lines(y = ~fit, line = list(color = PALETTE$primary, width = 2.2), hovertemplate = paste0(predictor_label(v), " %{x:.3~f}
", lab, " %{y:.2f}"), showlegend = FALSE) |> add_markers(x = s$data[[v]], y = rep(ylim[1], nrow(s$data)), inherit = FALSE, marker = list(symbol = "line-ns-open", size = 7, color = "rgba(31,42,55,0.35)"), hoverinfo = "skip", showlegend = FALSE) |> add_segments(x = x_now, xend = x_now, y = ylim[1], yend = ylim[2], inherit = FALSE, line = list(color = PALETTE$accent, width = 1.5, dash = "dash"), hoverinfo = "skip", showlegend = FALSE) |> layout(xaxis = list(title = predictor_label(v), zeroline = FALSE), yaxis = list(title = "", range = ylim)) }) ncol <- 3 subplot(panels, nrows = ceiling(length(panels) / ncol), margin = c(0.04, 0.02, 0.07, 0.07), titleX = TRUE, titleY = FALSE) |> style_plot(axes = FALSE) |> layout(margin = list(l = 85, r = 10, t = 10, b = 40), annotations = list(list(text = lab, x = -0.095, y = 0.5, xref = "paper", yref = "paper", textangle = -90, showarrow = FALSE, font = list(size = 13)))) }) output$tornado <- renderPlotly({ s <- scenario() lo <- as.numeric(input$range) tor <- tornado_data(model(), s$newdata, s$data, s$taxa, probs = c(lo, 1 - lo)) tor$dir <- ifelse(tor$var == "StreamOrder", "Stream order", ifelse(tor$at_high >= tor$at_low, "Rises with driver", "Falls with driver")) cols <- c("Rises with driver" = PALETTE$primary, "Falls with driver" = PALETTE$accent, "Stream order" = PALETTE$observed) xfmt <- function(v, x) ifelse(v == "StreamOrder", paste("order", x), fmt(as.numeric(x), 3)) tor$hover <- sprintf("%s
%s → %s
%s %s → %s
Swing %s", tor$label, xfmt(tor$var, tor$low_x), xfmt(tor$var, tor$high_x), metric_label(input$metric), fmt(tor$at_low), fmt(tor$at_high), fmt(tor$swing)) tor$label <- factor(tor$label, levels = tor$label) plot_ly(tor, y = ~label, x = ~swing, base = ~pmin(at_low, at_high), type = "bar", orientation = "h", color = ~dir, colors = cols, text = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text", textposition = "none") |> style_plot(xlab = metric_label(input$metric), legend = TRUE) |> layout( barmode = "overlay", yaxis = list(title = "", categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = levels(tor$label)), shapes = list(list(type = "line", x0 = tor$base[1], x1 = tor$base[1], y0 = 0, y1 = 1, yref = "paper", line = list(color = PALETTE$ink, dash = "dot", width = 1))), annotations = list(list(x = tor$base[1], y = 1.02, yref = "paper", showarrow = FALSE, text = paste("Scenario", fmt(tor$base[1])), font = list(size = 11))), legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.15), margin = list(l = 10, r = 20, t = 30, b = 60) ) }) }) }
